title: editor crash when opened .glb model changes
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878]
- Reproducible in `master` commit 34d06658a85845111a50db9e485ec4a0701d4298

### System information

MacOS 26.6.2, MB Pro M2

### Issue description

an external change in opened .glb model (eg. make changes in Blender & export into the file) crashes the editor

### Steps to reproduce

with the attached MRP project:

- open `cube.glb` model in editor 
- choose "Open Anyway" in the dialog ["Cancel" / "Open Inherited" / "Open Anyway" ]
- change content of the .glb model externally (eg. make changes in Blender & export into the file). To simulate the same effect without Blender, copy `cube2.glb` into `cube.glb` ( `cube1.glb` for second overwrite, then `cube2.glb` again...)
- editor crashes
